reviews.text:
The Big Book is a solid teaching for not only alcoholics, but others as well.. There’s so much good about the entire book. As an agnostic who definitely believes that the universe is bigger and more powerful than I am, I found that the broad scope of the book that allows each person to determine their “higher power”, or “God” if you would, makes sense. I’ve had an aversion to the word “God” all my life. No belief that a “he or she” exists, yet I can clearly see that I’m a part of a universe that is everything and that the power of that universe determines our lives. 

Taking the time to read the book and to start really working the steps as a family member who is impacted by alcoholism he’s brought me so much more understanding of the illness and allowed me to be a better partner and parent. 

Priceless work!

reviews.text:
Would be great, if..... This app hasn’t been updated since apple released iPhones with bigger screens, and so it doesn’t fill up the entire screen. For an app that costs $12.99, I would expect better. 

The biggest flaw that it has is that it doesn’t save your place when listening. This is a problem, especially when listening to a longer, 8 hour workshop. Maybe you don’t open the app for two days, then when you do, you have to remember which chapter you were listening to. If you can do that, at least the app remembers where you left off in that track. 

Still - it should have that track loaded and ready to start where you left off in a “now playing” section. This seems like such a basic feature that it knocked my review from 5-stars to 2-stars. An outdated interface, I can almost forgive. This fundamental flaw, however, I cannot. 

I hope the developer can correct these two flaws so that I can come back and revise my review to be 5-stars and glowing.

reviews.text:
Game changer!. I’m a Florida Firefighter Paramedic and have been sober for 71 months. I would consider it very Good Sobriety. My spiritual condition and ability to deal with life on life’s terms is usually top notch. I owe a lot of those true promises to this app. I have a sponsor and a homegroup but using Audiojoy I have listen many times to the Big Book and Twelve and twelve. I have all of my sponsees use it. We listen to the speakers and share our thoughts, I listen to Joe and Charlie and Barefoot Bill when working steps with a guy. And I use the meditations and chants and bells to meditate daily. When I share at meetings I often here that people are amazed that I only have 3 years sobriety. My mind, my Marriage, Job, relationships with my children and others and all of the gifts in my life today I owe to AA, a good sponsor, my sponsees, homegroup and the Great Spirit of the Universe whom I call God. But I owe a lot to this Audiojoy app. Please take some time to try it out then purchase the unlimited version.

Strength Love and Prayers,

Kenny Church 
West Palm Beach, Fl

reviews.text: Love this Audio Collection. I have been attending Alcoholics Anonymous since 1995 and it literally saved my life. There have been years I attended well over 200 meetings a year- maybe even close to 300. Now I am so busy I can’t attend as many meetings as I want to- I average maybe 3 a week and my goal is 5. This audio app fills the gap with the literature I need to work the program in my life. The meetings I crave are literature based, yet I also enjoy the experience strength and hope meetings of what it was like, what happened, and what it’s like now. This is a good app for the bus ride and when I get a chance to work on my recovery. For me this is literally a life and death issue. Thanks for this audio collection.
